imageTag.description: Image tag used for main driver pod. Default value is {@link ExMachina_Config#exmacDriverImageTag}.

waitForReady.description: Decision to wait for service to be fully operational.

requestTimeoutMinutes.description: THe Http request timeout in minutes.

dynamicResourceAllocation.description:
Enable Spark dynamic resource allocation. Note that the 'minExecutors', 'maxExecutors', 'executorTimeoutSeconds', 'executorAllocationRatio'
will not have an effect unless this is enabled.

minExecutors.description: The minimum number of executors that will be active at any time.

maxExecutors.description: The maximum number of executors that can be active at any time.

executorTimeoutSeconds.description: How long, in seconds, an executor can be idle before shutting down.

executorAllocationRatio.description: This many tasks will be assigned to each executor. If there is tasks remaining, more executors will be provisioned.
